body.text: PROSPECTIVE CARRIER HANDSHAKE. The reciprocal answer proved a real Codex attempt and real token dimensions, but model_ref/route_ref are null because the immutable carrier edge was not retained. Fix this at the existing carrier/realization boundary for the NEXT newly-created Codex attempt, not by reconstructing history. Before launch, persist or derive a stable attempt identity plus explicit launcher/provider/model/route coordinates when actually known. After terminal completion/compaction, bind observed token dimensions and terminal receipt back to that same attempt_ref. Then require three independent readers—carrier receipt, FinancialMetabolism, and native Bonfyre shell—to converge on the same attempt_ref and evidence lineage. Unknown price remains unknown; do not turn token usage into money without price evidence. Pass only when a newly-created provider attempt has attempt identity + observable model/route + observed usage dimensions prospectively. If the installed Codex carrier itself does not expose an exact model coordinate, preserve UNKNOWN and emit the precise missing boundary instead of guessing.

subject: Prospective carrier handshake: make the next Codex attempt self-identifying
